entries.title: Job 6:1
segments: ¶But Job answered and said,

entries.title: Job 6:2
segments: Oh that my grief were throughly weighed, and my calamity laid in the balances together! {laid: Heb. lifted up}

entries.title: Job 6:3
segments: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea: therefore my words are swallowed up. {my words...: that is, I want words to express my grief}

words.text: For now it would be heavier
. {my words...: that is, I want words to express my grief}

entries.title: Job 6:4
segments: For the arrows of the Almighty [are] within me, the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit: the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me.

entries.title: Job 6:5
segments: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder? {when he...: Heb. at grass?}

entries.title: Job 6:6
segments: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? or is there [any] taste in the white of an egg?

entries.title: Job 6:7
segments: The things [that] my soul refused to touch [are] as my sorrowful meat.

entries.title: Job 6:8
segments: ¶Oh that I might have my request; and that God would grant [me] the thing that I long for! {the thing...: Heb. my expectation}

words.text: [me] the thing that I long for

entries.title: Job 6:9
segments: Even that it would please God to destroy me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

words.text: me; that he would let loose

entries.title: Job 6:10
segments: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.

words.text: Then should I yet have comfort

entries.title: Job 6:11
segments: What [is] my strength, that I should hope? and what [is] mine end, that I should prolong my life?

entries.title: Job 6:12
segments: [Is] my strength the strength of stones? or [is] my flesh of brass? {of brass: Heb. brasen?}

entries.title: Job 6:13
segments: [Is] not my help in me? and is wisdom driven quite from me?

entries.title: Job 6:14
segments: ¶To him that is afflicted pity [should be shewed] from his friend; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty. {is afflicted: Heb. melteth}

entries.title: Job 6:15
segments: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, [and] as the stream of brooks they pass away;

entries.title: Job 6:16
segments: Which are blackish by reason of the ice, [and] wherein the snow is hid:

entries.title: Job 6:17
segments: What time they wax warm, they vanish: when it is hot, they are consumed out of their place. {vanish: Heb. are cut off} {when...: Heb. in the heat thereof} {consumed: Heb. extinguished}

words.text: . {vanish: Heb. are cut off} {when...: Heb. in the heat thereof} {consumed: Heb. extinguished}

entries.title: Job 6:18
segments: The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing, and perish.

entries.title: Job 6:19
segments: The troops of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited for them.

entries.title: Job 6:20
segments: They were confounded because they had hoped; they came thither, and were ashamed.

entries.title: Job 6:21
segments: For now ye are nothing; ye see [my] casting down, and are afraid. {ye are...: or, ye are like to them: Heb. to it} {nothing: Heb. not}

words.text: For now ye are nothing; ye see
. {ye are...: or, ye are like to them: Heb. to it} {nothing: Heb. not}

entries.title: Job 6:22
segments: ¶Did I say, Bring unto me? or, Give a reward for me of your substance?

words.text: unto me? or, Give a reward

entries.title: Job 6:23
segments: Or, Deliver me from the enemy's hand? or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?

entries.title: Job 6:24
segments: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue: and cause me to understand wherein I have erred.

words.text: me, and I will hold my tongue

entries.title: Job 6:25
segments: How forcible are right words! but what doth your arguing reprove?

entries.title: Job 6:26
segments: Do ye imagine to reprove words, and the speeches of one that is desperate, [which are] as wind?

entries.title: Job 6:27
segments: Yea, ye overwhelm the fatherless, and ye dig [a pit] for your friend. {ye overwhelm: Heb. ye cause to fall upon}

words.text: . {ye overwhelm: Heb. ye cause to fall upon}

entries.title: Job 6:28
segments: Now therefore be content, look upon me; for [it is] evident unto you if I lie. {evident...: Heb. before your face}

entries.title: Job 6:29
segments: Return, I pray you, let it not be iniquity; yea, return again, my righteousness [is] in it. {in it: that is, in this matter}

words.text: , I pray you, let it not be iniquity
[is] in it. {in it: that is, in this matter}

entries.title: Job 6:30
segments: Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things? {my taste: Heb. my palate}
